Did NOT rewrite the rest of either Stop Condition section (they already differ in wording/detail per the pre-existing CAM-224 drift noted in patterns.md; this story's AC only required a CAM-189 grep-match in both copies, not exact-match parity). Ran embed-vendor + embed-vendor:check (clean), typecheck (0 errors), bun test (3998 pass / 0 fail), check:all (all green).
